key.utilitysuite.hand_over: Hand over: hold to give the autopilot control
module.utilitysuite.radial_wheel.descrip: Hold the wheel key, flick the mouse toward a slice and release to run it
module.utilitysuite.schematic_toolkit.de: Import schematics, count materials, survey the site and assist building
message.utilitysuite.travel.automation_s: Automation is stopped (Stop-All). Resume it first.
message.utilitysuite.terrain.surface_on_: Surface mode on: walking on fluids (sneak to sink)
Surface mode on: staying at the surface (sneak to dive)
message.utilitysuite.terrain.surface_rej: Surface mode switched off: the server corrected your position %s times. This server does not allow it.
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.no_naviga: Autopilot: overland travel needs the pathfinder (Baritone)
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.not_in_bo: Autopilot: get in a boat first
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.ceiling: Autopilot: no cruising under a ceiling; use the Nether bounce mode
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.reserve_d: Autopilot: elytra worn, landing (a healthier elytra is in your inventory)
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.takeoff_b: Autopilot: need 6 blocks of open air above you to take off
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.takeoff_n: Autopilot: no rockets in the hotbar for the takeoff
Autopilot: the elytra did not open, takeoff stopped
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.elytra_sw: Autopilot: swapping in the spare elytra
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.mend_land: Autopilot: elytra worn, landing to mend it with bottles o' enchanting
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.mend_fail: Autopilot: out of bottles before the elytra was mended
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.searching: Autopilot: looking for a landing site
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.unloaded_: Autopilot: terrain ahead not loaded, holding altitude
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.hub_start: Autopilot (nether hub) to %s: ~%s blocks direct vs ~%s via the Nether
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.hub_to_en: Autopilot: leg 1/3, walking to the portal at %s %s
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.hub_nethe: Autopilot: leg 2/3, crossing the Nether to %s %s
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.hub_await: Autopilot: no portal recorded here; take a portal to the Overworld to continue (Stop to cancel)
message.utilitysuite.autopilot.hub_faile: Autopilot: unexpected dimension change, route stopped
Autopilot: the portal did not take you, route stopped
Autopilot: could not get into the portal, route stopped
message.utilitysuite.bridge.hotbar_low: Bridge: hotbar running low on blocks (%s placed)
message.utilitysuite.bridge.place_failed: Bridge: a block could not be placed (%s placed)
message.utilitysuite.bridge.fell: Bridge stopped: you left the deck (%s placed)
message.utilitysuite.bridge.not_on_groun: Bridge: stand on a block first
message.utilitysuite.bridge.need_marks: Bridge: mark point A and point B first
message.utilitysuite.bridge.off_line: Bridge: stand on point A or on the marked line
message.utilitysuite.bridge.walk_started: Walk bridge on: walk, blocks follow your feet
message.utilitysuite.bridge.walk_not_all: Walk bridge: instant pace and server look/sneak/sprint options need single-player or an allow-listed server (Tools tab)
button.utilitysuite.deposit.tooltip: Move items this container already holds into it
button.utilitysuite.dump.tooltip: Move everything except pinned hotbar slots into this container
message.utilitysuite.lava_plug_no_blocks: Lava opened, and no cobblestone or other filler block to plug it
module.utilitysuite.villager_helpers.des: Bulk trading in the trade screen and a librarian enchantment roller (bind the keys in Controls)
module.utilitysuite.quick_pearl.descript: One key throws an ender pearl where you look and puts your hotbar back (bind the key in Controls)
setting.utilitysuite.quick_pearl.blocked: Does not throw when the pearl would hit a block within 1.5 blocks of your eyes. Turn off for intentional close throws (up into a ceiling gap, a wall clip).
module.utilitysuite.dot_commands.descrip: Chat lines starting with . are handled locally and never sent: .t <module>, .goal <text>, .stop, .list, .help
module.utilitysuite.offhand_manager.desc: Keeps a totem at low health or while gliding, a shield against ranged threats, else your preferred offhand item
module.utilitysuite.auto_fish.descriptio: Reels in on a bite and recasts with human delays; stops before the rod breaks or the inventory fills
module.utilitysuite.auto_respawn.descrip: Respawns after a short delay and prints the death coordinates (never on hardcore)
module.utilitysuite.auto_reconnect.descr: Reconnects after an unexpected disconnect with a countdown and backoff, then resumes the running job
module.utilitysuite.stronghold_finder.de: Throw an eye of ender twice from spots 100+ blocks apart: the two paths are crossed, snapped onto the stronghold rings and saved as a waypoint
module.utilitysuite.trial_chambers.descr: Outlines vaults and trial spawners by state: ominous or normal, open, reward, cooldown, and vaults you already opened
module.utilitysuite.sonar_pulse.descript: A key sends an expanding wavefront: surfaces, cave walls, spawners and predicted ores light up as it passes, then fade
module.utilitysuite.cavity_tomography.de: Outlines enclosed air voids under the surface in nearby chunks as wireframes coloured by depth
module.utilitysuite.change_tracker.descr: Snapshot chunks, then come back and see new blocks (cyan), removed blocks (amber) and containers that were emptied (red)
setting.utilitysuite.autopilot.black_box: Keep recording health and dangers while the autopilot is off, so a death during a plain job can still be looked at afterwards. Records only; nothing acts while it is off.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_reflexes.esc: Also back off from fuses while a goal job runs, even with the Combat Assistant and autopilot off. The job pauses and resumes once the blast is no longer a threat.
Off: flat plates and plain 1 px lines, no glow. Subtle: glow and soft lines. Full: everything.
setting.utilitysuite.appearance.motion.t: Off: every transition is instant. Reduced: fades only, no slides. Full: fades, slides and lock-on snaps.
setting.utilitysuite.appearance.accent.t: Colour of the system lines and highlights. Status colours (danger, warning, acting) stay fixed.
setting.utilitysuite.appearance.hud_opac: Multiplies the opacity of everything the suite draws on the in-game HUD. The menu ignores it.
setting.utilitysuite.appearance.hud_scal: Size of the suite's in-game HUD on top of the game's GUI scale. The menu keeps its own scale.
setting.utilitysuite.suite_hud.control_s: Right side, only while something acts: who holds which controls, the phase of Movement Assist, the Combat Assistant and the travel autopilot, and for 10 s after it happened the last override, refusal or preemption with who caused it. Hidden with F1 and Clean-Screen.
setting.utilitysuite.suite_hud.module_li: List of the modules that are on, top-right, longest name first, with a category colour bar. The autopilot heads it while it is on; a module acting right now is marked. Hidden with F1, F3 and Clean-Screen.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.con: Corrections: small per-tick corrections, your keys always stand. Co-pilot (default): a jump at a locked block is held from takeoff to a stable landing; it fills keys you are not using and lets go of a key you held since before the jump, never one you just pressed. Takeover: hold a movement key toward the block and it flies the jump.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.ove: How quickly your own input takes a jump back. High: sooner. Low: the assist holds on longer. Sneak always hands everything back at once.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.lan: On a narrow landing (a fence post, a wall, a pane, a 1-block pillar) sneak from the last air tick, and every key you held through the jump stays off until you release it. Press a key again, jump or sneak and it is yours at once. Never while you hold jump.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.hol: Fresh input: the sneak lifts once you stand still and press something new. Timer: it lifts after the limit below. Either way a key held through the jump stays off until you release it.
Ticks (50 ms each) the sneak stays on after you are stable before it lifts by itself.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.hi: Auto: open and re-engage with a sprint knockback hit, keep combos with knockback, crit when knockback is worth little (cornered or eating target, out-damaged, a big mob), sweep only when two or more hostiles stand together and nothing else is in reach of the sweep. Knockback, Crits or Plain force one kind.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.du: Never run from the fight or drop it when the target gets far or out of sight while it is alive and loaded: back off, heal and come back instead. For closed arenas and boss rooms.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.co: Takeover (default): the assistant fights for you (movement, camera, clicks) and a movement key of yours ends the fight. Co-pilot: you keep WASD and the mouse; it eases your aim toward the target a little (not on the Legit level), holds W back instead of crowding it or walking into its charged hit, times your sprint resets, and swings at full charge while your crosshair is on it. Holding the hand-over key still hands the fight over.

Ease your view toward the target, only while it is already near your crosshair (within 60 degrees) and close; at most 20 degrees per swing. Move the mouse against it and it lets go for two seconds. Pitch stays yours. Never on the Legit level.
While you hold W at the target, hold it back for a few ticks instead of crowding it or walking into its charged hit while your own swing is still charging. Press W again and it stays yours.

Swing at full charge (waiting for the fall of a hop for a crit) while your own crosshair is on the target in reach. Never into a raised shield that faces you unless you hold an axe, never while you use an item, and your own clicks always win. Off leaves every click to you.
setting.utilitysuite.survival.use_invent: Use food from the whole inventory
Pull the best food from the pack into the hotbar when the hotbar has none
setting.utilitysuite.survival.eat_swap_b: Put the hotbar item back after eating food pulled from the pack
setting.utilitysuite.inventory.refill_sa: When a tool, weapon, totem or food runs out, refill the slot with the best remaining item of the same kind (unpinned slots)
Also let pinned slots take a different item of the same kind
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.co_: During a committed jump on Balanced and above, the camera eases toward the jump line (smoothed, a few degrees per jump, never faster than the camera cap). Your mouse always comes through; turning against it hands the view back for that jump. Never on Legit or in Corrections.
setting.utilitysuite.appearance.font.too: Suite: a clean UI typeface with tabular numerals, once its font files are installed (vanilla until then, and whenever Force Unicode Font is on). Vanilla: always the game's own font.
setting.utilitysuite.appearance.armed_ma: Shows four dim corner brackets while the autopilot is on and idle.
ui.utilitysuite.timeline.title: Packet Lab timeline
ui.utilitysuite.minimap.layout_hint: Drag to move, corner to resize. ESC or Done to save.
ui.utilitysuite.minimap.layout_off: Minimap is off (turn it on in the World tab).
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.sh: Never swing into a raised shield that faces you: circle to its open side and hit the moment it comes down. After an axe disables it, press with crits for the 5 seconds.

With a shield in the offhand: raise it just before the opponent's charged hit, take the hit on it, lower and answer inside their cooldown. Never against an axe, never while eating, only with the opponent in front of you.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.th: While fighting mobs: switch to the biggest threat (a swelling creeper, a skeleton drawing at you, a mob about to hit from behind), back out of a creeper's blast while it swells, strafe out of a drawn bow's line, and spread a pack out. Only mobs already attacking you count.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.mo: Fight each mob the way a pro does: sprint hits on creepers, no crit hops into a spider's leap or onto a baby zombie, close on skeletons with a strafe, rush witches. Unknown and modded mobs get the normal fight.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.co: Against a player: after two hits taken without landing one, stop trading from the air and strafe out of the knockback line (along the wall when pinned) until your hit lands or half a second passes. Never backpedals straight.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.he: Heal in hits left and only when the opponent cannot hit for most of the eat; make a window (knockback hit, route around cover) when there is none. Needs Emergency sustain.
Heal when this many of the opponent's measured hits would take you out.
With the opponent away, eat hotbar food that wastes nothing while hunger is below 18.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.app: Co-pilot and Takeover ease the run-up and pick the takeoff tick so a near, narrow landing can be stopped on.
